title: Generative Semantic Scene Completion
abstract: arXiv:2608.26737v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Outdoor LiDAR semantic scene completion (SSC) recovers a dense semantic voxel grid from a scan observing 1% of the target volume, under class imbalance beyond 7,000x. We recast SSC as generative semantic scene completion (GSSC): a single discrete-diffusion formulation in three roles. First, paired sparse-dense scene synthesis (PS$^3$) generates matched sparse LiDAR observations with their dense semantic completions, addressing the long tail at its source and yielding the PS$^3$-SemanticKITTI corpus we train on alongside SemanticKITTI. Second, semantic-guided generative scene completion (SGSC) generates the scene from noise with multinomial discrete diffusion, conditioned on the sparse scan through a bird's-eye-view semantic map and a sparse 3D feature stream. Third, the same framework instead refines an existing completion in one flow-matching step: structured source discrete diffusion (S$^2$D$^2$). S$^2$D$^2$ improves the mIoU of SGSC

translated_abstract: 户外LiDAR语义场景补全（SSC）从扫描中恢复出密集的语义体素网格，该扫描仅观察目标体积的1%，且类别不平衡超过7000倍。我们将SSC重新定义为生成式语义场景补全（GSSC）：一种单一离散扩散公式，承担三个角色。首先，配对稀疏-密集场景合成（PS³）生成匹配的稀疏LiDAR观测及其密集语义补全，从源头解决长尾问题，并生成我们与SemanticKITTI一起训练的PS³-SemanticKITTI语料库。其次，语义引导的生成式场景补全（SGSC）通过多项式离散扩散从噪声生成场景，并以鸟瞰语义图和稀疏3D特征流为条件，基于稀疏扫描。第三，同一框架通过一步流匹配步骤优化现有补全：结构化源离散扩散（S²D²）。S²D²提升了SGSC的mIoU。
tldr: 本文提出生成式语义场景补全（GSSC）框架，利用统一离散扩散模型实现稀疏-密集场景合成、生成式补全和一步优化，显著提升户外LiDAR语义补全性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Generative Semantic Scene Completion (GSSC), a unified discrete-diffusion framework for paired sparse-dense synthesis, generative completion, and one-step refinement, enhancing outdoor LiDAR semantic completion performance.
